issue: Dealer Edit is simulated in local storage
root_cause: Frontend simulates API update via localStorage.getItem('dealer_patches'). Changes never sent to DB.
recommended_fix: Implement backend PUT /api/admin/staff/update/{id} and integrate into Dealers.jsx.

issue: Dealer Deletion is simulated in local storage
root_cause: Dealer ID is pushed to patches.deleted in localStorage. Backend account remains active.
recommended_fix: Implement backend DELETE /api/admin/staff/delete/{id} and invoke on confirm.

issue: Staff account suspension is simulated in local storage
root_cause: toggleStatus updates localStorage.getItem('admin_staff_status'). Backend DB is never notified.
recommended_fix: Connect toggleStatus to PUT /api/admin/deactivate/{id} or a backend status endpoint.

issue: Staff page permissions stored in admin browser storage
root_cause: Checkbox state saved to staff_page_access_${email} in local storage. Other admins and staff see default permissions.
recommended_fix: Create backend table admin_staff_permissions and save permissions via API.

issue: Remote session stop impersonates customer via Google login
root_cause: Calls /user/google-login-success?email=... to obtain user token before calling /sessions/stop.
recommended_fix: Update backend /sessions/stop to authorize admin Bearer tokens natively.

issue: Slot edit performs non-atomic delete followed by create
root_cause: Deletes slot via DELETE /slots/{id}, then creates new slot. If create fails, slot is lost.

issue: N+1 sequential HTTP fetch cascade on station locations
root_cause: Iterates over stations to fire individual GET /location/get/{id} requests, degrading load performance.
recommended_fix: Eagerly join Location data in backend GET /api/stations/all response.

root_cause: Synchronous import of complete worldwide postal database in station forms forces 8.7MB bundle chunk.
recommended_fix: Lazy load dataset dynamically or replace with backend /api/geo/countries endpoint.

issue: 9 ESLint compilation errors fail lint checks
root_cause: Unused variables: Sidebar.jsx:1, Batteries.jsx:1038, InventoryStock.jsx:22, MaterialOut.jsx:83, MaterialReports.jsx:48, ScmDashboard.jsx:228,254,316.
recommended_fix: Remove or prefix unused variables with _ per project ESLint configuration.

issue: Endpoint path mismatch between service and UI form
Endpoint path mismatch between service and UI page
root_cause: supportService.js calls /support/all, but UI makes direct fetch to /support-requests/admin/all.
recommended_fix: Align supportService.js with active backend /support-requests/* endpoints.

issue: Endpoint path mismatch for RFID cards
root_cause: userService.js defines /rfid/all, but UI makes direct fetch to /rfid-card.

issue: Schema workaround encodes charger ID in plan description
root_cause: Prefixes [C:${chargerId}] into description string because DB entity lacks charger_id foreign key.
recommended_fix: Add column charger_id to database Plan entity and update DTO.

root_cause: Redundant or unreferenced files left in repository without active imports.
recommended_fix: Safely deprecate and delete confirmed dead code files.

issue: axios installed in dependencies but unused
root_cause: Application uses native fetch across all services and pages.
recommended_fix: Remove axios from package.json to reduce node_modules size.
